STEP 10. Check the passenger's door lock key cylinder 
switch connector E-06 and ETACS-ECU connector C-112 
for damage.
Q: Are passenger's door lock key cylinder switch 
connector E-06 and ETACS-ECU connector C-112 in 
good condition?
YES : Go to Step 13.
NO : Repair or replace them. Refer to GROUP 00E, 
Harness Connector Inspection P.00E-2. The input 
signal from the passenger's door lock key cylinder 
switch should be able to be checked and the 
functions, which are described in the "Technical 
Description (comment)," should work normally.
